system.description: Once per session during an intense action sequence, you tag 3 scene elements right away, and 1 later in the sequence. When an ally interacts with a tagged element, you assist without risk on the roll. If no roll is needed, they take spark. You can push yourself to do it again.

notes.description: Scene elements may come from the GM's description, or they could be things that would logically be there. Establish details if needed, the GM will step it in if it's too far.
